purpose: Freeze implementation-only mechanics that were not outcome-adaptively selectable in v0.61 before the first pg15training row-level execution. This seal does not change the registered source, features, targets, model hyperparameters, gates, stage ordering or evidence budget.

pre_outcome_access_barrier.canonical_policy_id_rule: if numeric, require finite integer-valued and render base-10 integer without decimal suffix; otherwise trim surrounding whitespace, map a text suffix .0... to the same integer representation when the entire string is signed digits plus zero-only decimal suffix, otherwise retain the trimmed string exactly
pre_outcome_access_barrier.calendar_year_rule: finite integer-valued and exact observed set {2009, 2010}
pre_outcome_access_barrier.cross_year_policy_rule: remove every row for every canonical policy id observed in more than one distinct calendar year before constructing any exposure, claim-count, claim-cost or modelling array
pre_outcome_access_barrier.same_year_duplicate_policy_rows: retain; deterministic hash split is by canonical policy id so all same-id development rows remain in the same partition

split_implementation.hash_input: UTF-8 bytes of literal salt v61|S1|20260825| followed immediately by canonical policy id
split_implementation.bucket_rule: integer value of full SHA256 hex digest modulo 10000

preprocessing.categorical_value_conversion: nonmissing values converted to Python string after pre-outcome barrier

stage_decision_labels.second_execution_opening_rule: only a first execution with both target gates passing may be repeated for positive-stage reproducibility; a first-execution target failure is terminal for this request
